title: Oven Toasted Argentinian Ladyfingers Trifle
description: A nutty and aerated dessert featuring savoiardi ladyfingers, this Argentinian dish is smoke hot and gluten free friendly, perfect for cozy nights.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the dulce de leche, granulated sugar, large eggs, and pure vanilla extract.
Fold the whipped cream into the dulce de leche mixture until well combined.
Arrange half of the savoiardi ladyfingers in the bottom of a large serving dish.
Pour half of the dulce de leche mixture over the ladyfingers.
Sprinkle half of the chopped pecans and half of the smoked sea salt over the top.
Repeat the layers, starting with the remaining ladyfingers, then the remaining dulce de leche mixture, and finally the remaining pecans and smoked sea salt.
Place the serving dish in the oven and toast for 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
